title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
title_zh: AutoPILOT：面向实时游戏的视觉智能体运行框架
abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across closed and open-source models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.
abstract_zh: 当游戏可以暂停等待时，多模态基础模型往往表现良好；一旦游戏持续运行，表现就容易下滑。作者发现，这一差距很大程度上源于智能体运行框架（harness）：它决定模型看到什么、记住什么，以及如何将输出转化为随时间执行的动作。VISTA 等框架改进了感知和记忆，但每次模型调用至多执行一个动作，导致行动频率受限于推理频率。AutoPILOT 解耦了两者：模型每次调用可以发出一个原子动作、启动一段开环宏指令，或编写一个闭环控制器。闭环控制器依据画面反馈持续操作，无需再次调用模型，直至交还控制权。为评估实时表现，作者构建了 AFK-Bench，收录 120 款浏览器游戏，按游戏对智能体不采取行动的响应方式分组，并支持实时与暂停计时两种模式。在相同预算下，使用 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 AutoPILOT 在 AFK-Bench 上的实时成功率为 68.6%，高于 VISTA 的 38.3%。在 GameWorld 上，AutoPILOT 的实时成功率为 80.0%，而 VISTA 从暂停计时下的 84.1% 降至实时模式下的 42.9%。这一优势在闭源和开源模型上均有体现；AutoPILOT 仅用 VISTA 五分之一的 API 成本便达到其最终成功率。
key_points_zh: 实时游戏的瓶颈不只在于感知和记忆：每次推理只执行一个动作，会让模型推理频率限制行动频率。
AutoPILOT 支持原子动作、开环宏指令和闭环控制器；闭环控制器可根据画面反馈连续操作，无需逐步调用模型。
AFK-Bench 包含 120 款浏览器游戏，按游戏对不操作的响应分组，支持对比实时与暂停计时表现。
同预算下，GPT-6.1 Sol 在 AFK-Bench 上的实时成功率从 VISTA 的 38.3% 提升至 AutoPILOT 的 68.6%；在 GameWorld 上，两者的实时成功率分别为 42.9% 和 80.0%。
收益覆盖闭源和开源模型；AutoPILOT 仅用五分之一的 API 成本即可达到 VISTA 的最终成功率。
